parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: "accepted", message: "Test Strategy generation started for project: " + ($('Initialize Parameters').first().json.projectSlug || "unknown"), stage: "test-strategy", workflow: "Test Strategy", projectSlug: $('Initialize Parameters').first().json.projectSlug || "unknown", projectName: $('Initialize Parameters').first().json.projectName || $('Initialize Parameters').first().json.projectSlug || "unknown" } }}

parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.slug, p.name FROM architecture.projects p WHERE p.slug = $1;
SELECT id FROM architecture.jobs WHERE project_id = $1 AND stage = 'risk-assessment' AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
INSERT INTO architecture.jobs (project_id, stage, input_job_id, status, meta) VALUES ($1, 'test-strategy', $2, 'running', $3::jsonb) RETURNING id, stage, status;

SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.type) a.type, a.content FROM architecture.artifacts a WHERE a.project_id = $1 AND a.type IN ('brd', 'application_arch', 'solution_arch_md', 'openapi_yaml', 'asyncapi_yaml', 'risk_assessment_md') ORDER BY a.type, a.version DESC;

WITH next_version AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 AS v FROM architecture.artifacts WHERE project_id = $1 AND type = $2) INSERT INTO architecture.artifacts (project_id, type, version, content, content_hash, meta) SELECT $1, $2, next_version.v, $3::jsonb, $4, $5::jsonb FROM next_version RETURNING id, version;
UPDATE architecture.jobs SET status = 'completed', completed_at = now() WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, status;
